Card Studio

Fill it in, pick a look and a tune, then download a card to email.

Theme
Music

To send: attach the downloaded file to an email and tell them to open it — it plays in their browser. Pasting it into the email body won't work (email strips the music & animation).

Live preview shows the card already opened. In the real file it starts closed with a “Tap to open”, and the music plays on that first tap.
